user.title: Add ESL label
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of the label. Advertised addresses start with 66:66.

data_description.scan_interval_min: How often to connect for status and version. Battery level arrives passively from advertisements, so a long interval is fine.

error.invalid_address: Not a valid Bluetooth address, expected AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF

abort.already_configured: This label is already set up

on_ms.name: On time
on_ms.description: Blink on time in milliseconds. Defaults to the RGB on time number entity.

off_ms.name: Off time
off_ms.description: Blink off time in milliseconds. Defaults to the RGB off time number entity.

work_ms.name: Duration
work_ms.description: Total run time in milliseconds. Defaults to the RGB duration number entity.

set_image.name: Set image
set_image.description: Renders an image file and uploads it to the panel. Experimental: the pixel format is not documented by the vendor.

path.name: File path
path.description: Path to the image. Must be inside an allowed directory.

rotate.name: Rotation
rotate.description: Rotate the image before fitting it to the panel.

invert.name: Invert
invert.description: Invert black and white on 1 bit panels.
